test_title: PYST 06: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in Direct Speech.

She said that she was learning French.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** She said that she was learning French.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"she was learning French" becomes "I am learning French"**
 
 
• Pronoun "she" is changed to "I" to match direct speech.
 
• Verb "was learning" is changed to "am learning" to reflect the present continuous tense.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Indirect: "She said"
 
• Converted to: "She said," maintaining the reporting clause format.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "I" and ends with a period ".".
 
• Reporting clause follows the quoted speech, separated by a comma.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I am learning French,” she said."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "I learn French," she said.

 
 
• Incorrect tense: "learn" suggests a habitual action instead of the ongoing action described in the original sentence.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "I was learning French," she said.
 
 
• Incorrect tense: "was learning" reflects past continuous, which does not match the original meaning.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "I have learned French," she said.
 
 
• Incorrect tense: "have learned" suggests a completed action, altering the meaning of the sentence.
